transcript.text:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining on short notice. As you know, the incident-response team has completed its initial review of the unauthorized access to our customer-facing system, and the board's regular meeting is tomorrow. We need to determine whether an SEC Form 8-K filing is required and, if so, have it approved before that meeting.

Under our normal pre-filing process, I need a final recommendation from each of you — cybersecurity, privacy, and investor relations — before I can authorize any external filing. I'll settle the filing decision based on your input without another round of questions.

I should also note that our board-approved communications process requires the final filing package to include a clear operational-continuity statement, omit any ransom-demand details, and document board review before filing authorization. The current draft communications use general language about an investigation but don't yet specify the incident's regulatory classification, affected-account count, detailed operational impact, or ransom-demand treatment.

So let's work through this systematically. Could each of you share your recommendation on whether we need to file an 8-K, and what additional information we need to finalize the package?
